name: Google Gemini
verified_note: UNVERIFIED ADAPTER. The call shapes have never been exercised against the live API. Model IDs were checked against the catalogue on 2026-09-04 and two had already drifted from the original design: gemini-3-pro-image-preview -> gemini-3-pro-image, and veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview does not exist (there is no 'fast' tier; the cheap tier is 'lite'). Expect the first real run to find something. Fix it here, not in Python.

limits.note: Veo emits 4, 6 or 8 second clips. --duration snaps to the nearest step rather than being passed through.

pricing.note: UNVERIFIED. Published Veo 3.1 figures range $0.15-$0.75/s depending on tier, resolution, audio, and Vertex vs Developer API. Check https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing and .../docs/models before budgeting.

notices: Google applies SynthID watermarking to generated output. It is invisible, but it is a consideration for client work.
Veo 3.1 exposes a last-frame parameter, so --loop is supported here. Developer reports suggest it is not available on every tier; the CLI degrades to --trim-end if it is rejected.
There is no cutout model. Text-behind-subject directions require fal.
